tools.name: compare_platforms
tools.description: Ranks all 13 supported US resale platforms by profit for the same sale (each platform's default options). Returns fees, payout, profit and margin per platform, with a link to each fliprofit.com calculator and the side-by-side compare tool.

tools.name: get_fee_changes
tools.description: Machine-readable log of real, dated US marketplace fee changes (rate changes, new fees, caps, promotions, ending discounts), each with the platform's own source URL and the date Fliprofit last verified it. Filter by platform, by effective date, or to upcoming changes only.
